[SWS_EM_01303]
{OBSOLETE}
Cyclic Execution Control Sequence
⌈
The return
code of
ara::exec::DeterministicClient::WaitForActivation
shall follow
this sequence:
kRegisterServices
,
kServiceDiscovery
,
kInit
,
kRun
, and
kTerminate
. Note that
kRun
is expected to be returned multiple times.
⌋
(RS_EM_-
00052)
